body:
Healthcare Compliance Pros hosted an educational webinar on the release of the Final Rule for MACRA and information on MIPS implementation for your organization.

HCP has extensively researched and documented the new rules and their impact on physician reimbursement, including the "Pick Your Pace" options. With the release of the Final Rule the impact to your organization couldn't be greater. Learn more about how you need to be prepared for 2017.

You can view the webinar here.
